north_sea_union.name: North Sea Commonwealth
north_sea_union.description: A maritime energy and shipping confederation uniting Britain, Norway, the Netherlands and Denmark around the North Sea basin.

pyrenean_union.name: Pyrenean Confederation
pyrenean_union.description: A trans-Pyrenean Atlantic-Mediterranean union binding France, Spain and Andorra under one constitutional market.

adriatic_alps_union.name: Alpe-Adria Confederation
adriatic_alps_union.description: An Alpine-Adriatic commonwealth connecting Vienna, Ljubljana, Zagreb and Rome across shared mountain passes and ports.

balkan_black_sea_accord.name: Pontic-Danube Commonwealth
balkan_black_sea_accord.description: A Black Sea and lower-Danube confederation linking Ukraine, Romania, Moldova, Bulgaria and Georgia in a shared maritime corridor.

caspian_commonwealth.name: Caspian Basin Federation
caspian_commonwealth.description: A trans-Caspian energy and transit republic uniting Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan across the middle corridor.

red_sea_federation.name: Red Sea Maritime Union
red_sea_federation.description: A strategic strait federation linking Suez to Bab el-Mandeb under unified maritime security and port governance.

great_lakes_african_union.name: African Great Lakes Federation
great_lakes_african_union.description: A highland East-Central African federation unifying the Great Lakes watersheds, railways and mineral trade routes.

zambezi_confederation.name: Zambezi Basin Commonwealth
zambezi_confederation.description: A southern-central African federation spanning the Zambezi corridor from the Atlantic coast to the Indian Ocean.

atlas_sahara_union.name: Atlas-Sahara Confederation
atlas_sahara_union.description: An Atlantic-Sahel federation linking Morocco, Mauritania, Senegal and Mali across coastal ports and trans-Saharan highways.

indus_himalaya_accord.name: Indus-Karakoram Federation
indus_himalaya_accord.description: A highland trade and watershed federation binding Pakistan, Afghanistan and Tajikistan from the Pamirs to the Arabian Sea.

silk_steppe_union.name: Eurasian Steppe Commonwealth
silk_steppe_union.description: An inner-Asian continental commonwealth uniting Kazakhstan, Mongolia and Kyrgyzstan along historic steppe railways.

coral_sea_federation.name: Coral Sea Maritime Union
coral_sea_federation.description: A Melanesian-Australian oceanic union safeguarding fisheries, cables and shipping across the Coral Sea.

northern_andes_federation.name: Equatorial Andes Commonwealth
northern_andes_federation.description: A Pacific-Caribbean Andean federation linking Colombia, Ecuador, Peru and Venezuela in one integrated republic.

southern_atlantic_accord.name: South Atlantic Federation
southern_atlantic_accord.description: A bi-oceanic southern cone republic uniting Argentina, Chile and Uruguay from the Strait of Magellan to the Rio de la Plata.

laurentian_commonwealth.name: North Atlantic Continental Union
laurentian_commonwealth.description: A northern oceanic confederation spanning Canada, the United States, Iceland and Denmark across the Arctic-Atlantic corridor.
